title: Nutty Blondies
description: Fudgy, gooey blondies made from sweet potato, white hot chocolate powder and almond butter. The sweet potato mimics eggs, sugar and flour while sneaking in your five-a-day.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan. Line a 25cm square baking tray.
Boil the sweet potato for 7 minutes until softened. Drain and mash over the heat to evaporate excess water.
Mix the hot chocolate powder and almond butter in a bowl. Add the sweet potato a spoonful at a time and mix thoroughly.
Tip into the baking tray, spread out with a palette knife and bake for 30 minutes until the top is set and edges are browning.
Cool in the tin before slicing.
notes: Makes 16 blondies. Per blondie estimate. Drizzle with melted white chocolate if you have some.
